text:
Maria (oncall): Olvera Health just escalated a P1 — p99 embedding latency spikes causing search timeouts for some users. CS says it started ~08:45 PDT and is blocking a live demo. Need quick alignment on owner + workaround timeline.
Zoe (customer-success): Confirmed. They see 5–7s p99 on embedding API and ~15% timeout rate. No deploys on their side. They're asking for ETA on mitigation.
Jin (eng-platform): I'm looking at routing and pool saturation. Dedicated pools are fine but hosted autoscale spiked and some requests landed on slower quantized replicas. Could be kernel hot path degradation.
Ashok (eng-ml): On it. Early signs point to cache eviction behavior + a model variant fallback that increases seq length. Suggest temporary routing rule to force smaller embed variant: `model: redwood-embed-mini-qdq`. Low risk, quick.
Olivia (sre): +1 for routing rule as short-term. Also suggest increasing request timeouts for the customer to avoid frontend OOMs while we mitigate.
Maria (oncall): Action items: (1) Jin implement routing override and push canary config; (2) Ashok validate smaller model quality for top-50 queries; (3) Olivia bump timeout and monitor alerts. Can we target a canary by EOD (PST)?
Jin (eng-platform): I can open PR for routing override now. Will push canary to 10% traffic for Olvera. PR will include YAML change: ```routes:
  - match: customer:olvera-health
    model: redwood-embed-mini-qdq
    weight: 100
```
Zoe (customer-success): If we go to a different model, notify Olvera immediately with rollback plan. They want a short SLA note.
Ashok (eng-ml): Quick perf check: running embedding quality diff on their sample set now. If top-10 recall drops <2% we can go ahead. ETA 45m.
Maria (oncall): Jin, tag @ashok and @olivia on the PR for faster review. Please post the PR link here. Jin, can you commit to the canary rollout by 17:30 PST?
Jin (eng-platform): Yes, aiming for 17:20 PST push. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/ops/PR/4821 (will update status).
deploy-bot: Canary started for routing-override PR #4821 — 10% traffic -> redwood-embed-mini-qdq for customer=olvera-health.
Olivia (sre): Watching metrics. Adding a temporary alert: `alert: OlveraEmbedP99High` with 10m burn. If >3s for 2 intervals, rollback and paging.
Ashok (eng-ml): Quality diff done: top-10 recall -1.1% on their sample; embeddings cosine avg delta 0.02. Looks safe for demo.
Zoe (customer-success): Passing this to Olvera: we'll route to a smaller model temporarily; CS will notify them and offer demo reschedule window if needed.
Maria (oncall): Outcome checklist: PR merged -> canary -> monitor 30m -> promote if stable. Owners: Jin (PR + rollout), Ashok (quality signoff), Olivia (alerts + timeout change), Zoe (customer comms).
Jin (eng-platform): PR merged at 17:22 PST. Canary warm, metrics look better — p99 dropped to ~700ms at 10% traffic.
Olivia (sre): After timeout bump and routing, error rate fell to 2%. Removing paging for now but keeping on-call watch for 2 hours.
Zoe (customer-success): Olvera confirmed demo can proceed with updated routing, appreciated the quick turn.
Maria (oncall): Great job. Follow-ups: Ashok to run full eval overnight and post notes; Jin to prepare a short postmortem of root cause and permanent fix plan; Olivia to remove temporary alert after 2h if stable. I'll close the incident thread in 4h unless anything regresses. :thumbsup:
